summary.headline: Autopatch-backed policies require Entra join or hybrid join
summary.summary: The prerequisites emphasize Microsoft Entra joined or hybrid joined devices; Microsoft Entra registered devices remain limited to Windows Update client policies and update rings.
summary.adminImpact: Check device join state before assigning feature, quality, or driver policies that use the Autopatch orchestration service.

summary.headline: Expedited update prerequisites keep prerelease builds out of scope
summary.summary: The quality update policy prerequisites visually separate the update-ring settings table, which requires Enable pre-release builds to remain Not configured because Beta and Dev builds are unsupported for expedited updates.
summary.adminImpact: Set Enable pre-release builds to Not configured before targeting an expedited quality update.

summary.headline: Migration guidance reflects January 2026 review
summary.summary: The migration guidance carries a January 8, 2026 date, indicating its planned review point.
summary.adminImpact: No new migration action is specified; continue validating migration plans against the current guidance.

summary.headline: Expedited quality update guidance is being consolidated
summary.summary: The expedited-update content participates in the move toward a consolidated quality update policy experience.
summary.adminImpact: Use the quality update policy guidance as the primary location for expedited-update configuration.

summary.headline: Update Ring settings navigation is simplified
summary.summary: The policy settings guidance removes an interim Update rings settings section heading as the reference is reorganized around the policy configuration flow.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current section layout to locate the setting you intend to configure.
